# lineage-openclaw

OpenClaw runtime/doc lineage. Donor of named-role/handoff/watchdog patterns
and Discord-native operator feel. Already absorbed into EMA's
`babysitter/` and incident model. **Mine for doctrine, do not resurrect.**

## Why this matters

OpenClaw is the doctrine ancestor of EMA's babysitter/incident model. Read this when you need to understand *why* the babysitter exists, not what it does (the what is in `codebase-ema/code/ema/daemon/lib/ema/babysitter/`).

## What lives here

- `docs/OpenClaw System Overview.md` — the original system shape
- `docs/OpenClaw Protocols.md` — handoff/role/watchdog protocols
- `docs/OpenClaw Agent Workspace Guide.md` — per-agent workspace pattern (precursor to the shared workspace contract)
- `runtime/openclaw.sanitized.json` — sanitized runtime config residue

## Where it connects

- Crystallized into: `codebase-ema` (`babysitter/`, `sessions/`, incidents/*)
- Surface-side residue lived on in: `codebase-claudeforge`, `codebase-place-org-openclaw`
- Knowledge ingest plans in: `docs-ema-next-steps/.../OPENCLAW-KNOWLEDGE-INGEST-PLAN.qmd`

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/lineage-openclaw:'docs/OpenClaw System Overview.md'
git show origin/lineage-openclaw:'docs/OpenClaw Protocols.md'
```
